hypothesis: The fixed D0-H32-s14000 parent yields enough successful, previously unused LIBERO trial4..7 episodes to support a new source-episode-disjoint action-conditioned consequence dataset.
single_variable: Only benchmark initial-state trial index changes from the already consumed trials0..3 to trials4..7; checkpoint, H3, action decoder, seed, task set, replan8 and no-ensemble deployment stay fixed.
parent_baseline: D0-H32-s14000/replan8/no-ensemble evaluated on trials0..3 produced 57/160 successes and supplied all C22/C25/C27 source episodes.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models
FACT failure rollout and action-conditioned consequence data path

architecture.paper: Failure data are collected from a fixed policy before consequence learning.
architecture.upstream_code: Failure rollouts augment the fixed training corpus.
architecture.local: The frozen D0-H32-s14000 parent generates all source episodes.
architecture.rationale: This stage only expands source states and does not train a model.

data.upstream_code: Success and failure episodes remain available.
data.local: All 160 suite/task/trial4..7 combinations are collected before selecting successful branch sources.
data.rationale: Selection covers the complete frozen index range rather than outcome-picked tasks.

action.upstream_code: Observed rollouts use decoded robot actions.
action.local: The incumbent environment-domain action decoder, normalized pre-clamp path, H32 prediction and replan8 execution are unchanged.
action.rationale: No candidate action mechanism is introduced in C29.

objective.paper: Consequence targets require sufficiently diverse rollouts.
objective.upstream_code: Training consumes all valid rollout records.
objective.local: C29 gates only source count and per-suite successful coverage; it makes no effect claim.
objective.rationale: Counterfactual branches and consequence learning are separate later stages.

optimization.paper: The model is optimized after data preparation.
optimization.upstream_code: Rollout collection itself performs no optimizer step.
optimization.local: Zero parameters update; 32 GPUs run 160 independent simulator episodes.

evaluation.paper: Held-out rollout success is the downstream metric.
evaluation.upstream_code: Evaluation enumerates fixed tasks and episodes.
evaluation.local: Audit requires all 160 exact paths and reports suite success counts; it is explicitly not a candidate comparison.
evaluation.rationale: The output determines whether enough fresh sources exist for the next data stage.

evidence: all suites/tasks and trials4..7 enumerated before launch
existing audited D0 environment action path
minimum total and per-suite source thresholds fixed before results

decision.rationale: C28 consumed all prior fresh sources and showed static ranking does not generalize; complete trial4..7 collection is the bounded prerequisite for a new action-conditioned consequence split.

result.boundary: This is a fixed-parent source inventory, not a candidate model comparison.
